Predicates:
Sucks(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuums ::: vacuums (as a class/category).
Vampires ::: vampires (as a class/category).
Space ::: space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a household appliance that is a duster.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
DoesNotSuck(x) ::: x doesn't suck.
Premises:
Plungers suck.
Vacuums suck.
Vampires suck.
Space is a vacuum.
Duster(x) ∧ DoesNotSuck(x) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
Space sucks.
